rows.q: My clothes smell bad after washing. What should I do?
Water is not going out of my machine. What do I check?
rows.reply: Check if the drain pump filter is blocked. (page 141)

rows.q: Can I wash my silk saree in it?
rows.reply: Yes, you can wash your silk saree in this program. (page 63)

rows.q: How much does a new rubber seal for the door cost?
The machine is jumping and banging when it spins. Why?
For how many years is the motor guaranteed?
My screen shows E35. What does it mean?
rows.reply: E35 indicates a door lock fault, where the door is not locked. Close the door firmly until it clicks; if the code stays, call service. (page 155)

rows.q: How do I stop my child from changing the wash settings?
Can I use the liquid I wash dishes with?
rows.reply: No, do not use dishwashing liquid or hand-wash soap as it makes too much foam and can leak and damage the machine. (page 104)
